completion_data.completion_summary: Added the canonical 'Batching Is the Default: Selection Criteria and Conflict Resolution' section to batch-orchestration-guardrails.md (posture, collision-visibility argument, three selection criteria, dominance rule with a definite winner for each pairwise conflict, MAX_TASKS=8 cap rule, and a deterministic worked example), pointed orchestrate.md/claudemd.md/multi-task-operations.md at it, and removed the contradicting 'common case' framing from multi-task-operations.md's Overview.

memory_candidates.content: To run check-task-references.sh or check-extension-docs.sh against uncommitted agent-system source-store edits (before a deploy has synced them to .claude/scripts/), use the documented REPO_ROOT override: `REPO_ROOT=$(pwd) bash agent-system/extensions/core/scripts/check-task-references.sh --quiet <path>` (check-extension-docs.sh takes no args, same override). The deployed .claude/scripts/ copy only reflects the last deploy and cannot see uncommitted source-store edits, and calling it from agent-system/extensions/core/scripts/ directly without the override fails loudly with a 'source store, not deployed tree' error.

When a task requires ruling on N pairwise conflicts among competing selection/priority criteria, write them as a literal N-row table with one definite 'Winner' column value per row (never 'Situational' or 'it depends'). This is a concrete grep target a plan or reviewer can check to confirm the requirement was actually met as a rule, not just discussed as a consideration.
